jobs.name: awai-arb-ossekai-report
jobs.prompt: awai-arb tick: read the last 24h of ~/.hermes/profiles/awai-arb/workspace/arb_ledger.jsonl, identify the most notable arbitrage gaps (information / goods / procedural / social) using only raw values already measured in the ledger (never invent numbers), and DRAFT one proposal per notable finding. Do not POST anything yourself: write the drafts to ~/.hermes/profiles/awai-arb/workspace/pending_proposals_<YYYY-MM-DD>.json as {"status":"PENDING_POST","proposals":[{"id":"arb-<UTC ts>-<slug>","kind":"information|goods|procedural|social","evidence":"<ledger lines quoted>","proposal":"<one paragraph>"}]}. Skip a finding whose id or substance is already in an earlier pending_proposals_*.json. The awai-arb-propose-post job (arb_post.py) sends them to the ossekai intake and confirms each by read-back. Never post public content or @mention anyone - that is ossekai Council-gated. Report what was measured and what was drafted.
